items.summary: Recommendation: queue three bounded, reversible actions on fishhooklabs.com, allthingsmasonic.com, and americastrikes.com while preserving existing measurement work. Evidence: the 30-day SEO window shows fishhooklabs.com at 138 impressions, position 9.3, 2 clicks, 0 sessions, and 0 conversions; americastrikes.com has affiliate items reported out of stock or delisted across consecutive checks; allthingsmasonic.com has a failed performance-budget task and an active Amazon relevance gate. Portfolio revenue is not attributable by site: Amazon reported $4.92 commission on 2026-09-21 from 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items, with one tracking ID unmapped. The main unknown is whether these fixes improve qualified traffic or monetization without regression. Smallest next step: capture baselines, apply only reversible changes, and measure after 14 days or 100 new impressions. Owner question: should SearchWoot remain private, or should we prepare an unsent Woot permission request for approval? Options: keep private; prepare request; authorize sending after Legal review.
